profile.headline: Senior Web Developer at Powerequipment Direct
profile.summary: An accomplished software engineer and full stack web developer specializing in analysis and design with extensive experience in the full life cycle of the software design process, including requirements definition, prototyping, proof of concept, design, coding, testing, implementation and maintenance. Quick learner that rapidly adapts to emerging technologies, and is experienced with many development methodologies.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description:
Senior Web Developer responsible for developing, testing and delivering updates and enhancements to the existing ecommerce platform using best practices and design methods and responsive design implementation. Created web applications and components from the planning stage to production deployment, including HTTP and Restful API interfaces. 
Technologies used include:
•	PHP, Javascript, Jquery, CSS 3, HTML 5 
•	OS Commerce ecommerce development
•	MySQL and PHPMyAdmin administration
•	Github source management
•	Jira task management

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description:
Senior Web Developer responsible for maintaining and enhancing websites and applications for the Digital Products team.  Rebuilt and reskinned all company websites using Clickability CMS, velocity and bootstrap.  Created intranet site and wiki using Wordpress and PHP.  Integrated RESTful web services, Omeda audience management integration, and DFP for publishers.  Maintained and enhanced existing ASP.NET C# web applications hosted on Heroku.

Technologies used include:
•	Velocity, PHP, ASP.NET, C#, Javascript, Jquery, HTML and Bootstrap
•	Clickability CMS, Wordpress CMS and Drupal CMS
•	Prototyping applications with Ruby on Rails and React.js
•	MySQL and PHPMyAdmin administration
•	Github source management
•	Amazon S3 cloud storage management
•	Heroku application platform integration

positions.title: Senior Production Developer
positions.description:
Lead Web Developer on the North America Production Web development team.  Responsible for project team coordination, design walkthroughs, code walkthroughs, CMS integration issues, acting as a technical lead for offshore and on site development teams, website troubleshooting, and maintaining developer documentation. 

•	Code walkthroughs and mentoring junior team members
•	PHP development and maintenance of existing applications
•	MySQL and PHPMyAdmin administration
•	standards-compliant HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Jquery, and an understanding of the "progressive enhancement" philosophy of web development
•	Subversion Source Control Management 
•	Linux administration and continuous integration servers
•	Object Oriented Design and Test Driven development methodologies
•	Responsive Web Development Experience
•	Involved with integrating Foundation, SASS, Angular.js, React.js, Node.js and Laravel to enable use with new CMS

positions.title: Programmer Analyst Developer
positions.description:
Application Developer / Analyst responsible for developing and maintaining CTPF’s pension administration system, Pension Gold, using a Delphi 5 IDE.  Additional roles include web application development, end user report development, data analysis, test plan creation and documentation. Added system responsibilities included software packaging and distribution, SQL Server Administration, Linux deployment and administration, and administration of issue tracking and Software change management systems.

Technologies used include:

•	Delphi 5 Enterprise Edition Development
•	Crystal Reports 8.5 development and Integration
•	SQL Server 2008 administration, Stored Procedures, Microsoft Business Intelligence Tools (Integration Services and Reporting Services)
•	Microsoft Office 2010, VBA, and Sharepoint maintenance
•	Bugzilla customization, deployment and administration
•	StarTeam installation and administration
•	Web development and support using HTML and PHP.
•	Ubuntu Linux Administration, Apache and Trac configuration, and Ruby on Rails deployments
•	Installshield MSI creation and WinInstall packaging and network deployment

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
CVS Caremark			Adjudication – Medicare Part D

Programmer / Analyst on a team performing analysis, coding, testing and daily reprocessing of Medicare Part D claims for clients of CVS Caremark.  Development was done in CICS, COBOL / DB2, JCL, FTP and Sharepoint.  Java/J2EE was also used in a related side project..

positions.title: Consultant Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
BlueStar Eligibility System – Health Statements

Lead Programmer / Analyst on a team performing analysis, coding and testing related to extracting membership information to allow the creation of online health statements.  Development is being done in COBOL / DB2 and Powerbuilder.  Expeditor and Endevor were also utilized.

BlueStar Members System – Oklahoma Integration

Programmer / Analyst on a team performing analysis, coding and testing related to integrating Blue Cross Blue Shield Oklahoma into the existing membership system of Blue Cross Blue Shield of Illinois.  Development was done in MAGNA, MQ and COBOL / DB2.

Product Catalogue Project

Data Analyst on a team which is building a logical data model to support a common product catalogue for the corporation.  This effort will lead to decision-making as to whether to buy a packaged product or develop an application in-house.  The next step will be to take this logical model and develop a physical database and ultimately to an application.

BlueStar Members System – National Carrier Project

Programmer / Analyst on a team which developed a new method of reporting for the Financial and Tax departments.  This is a new level of reporting to support the expanding focus of the company enabling tax and financial reporting at a state level.  Development was done in COBOL / DB2.

BlueStar Members System – Web Invoices / Settlements

Programmer / Analyst on a team creating a system of web based invoices and settlements for customers.  Was responsible for Database Design, program design, coding and testing. 
Development was done in COBOL / DB2 and Powerbuilder

positions.title: Consultant Unix Aministrator / Developer
positions.description: Functioned as Unix Administrator for this hotel corporation.  Responsibilities included:  Solaris  8 administration, creating and monitoring backups, troubleshooting, performance tuning, and ongoing support.  Ad hoc coding was done using JAVA, J2EE, EJB, JSP and XML.

positions.title: Consultant Unix Adminstrator
positions.description: Functioned as Unix Administrator for this government oriented e-business.  Responsibilities included:  Solaris 6 administration, upgrading to Solaris 7,  administering a development and QA environment, developing migration procedures for production applications and installing numerous software and support packages.  These packages included Weblogic, Open LDAP and installing and configuring Apache and Stronghold, troubleshooting, performance tuning, and ongoing support.  JAVA, J2EE, EJB and JSP development was also performed.

positions.title: Consultant Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Pricing Services/Full Integration

Programmer/Analyst on the enhanced integration of the Dominick’s warehousing and stores systems with the Safeway inventory management system.  The project involved complete merging of the systems using component level architecture on both MVS and UNIX.

Programmer/Analyst on the initial integration of the Dominick’s warehousing and stores systems with the Safeway inventory management system.  The project involved data conversion, analysis, design, coding and testing of interfaces between the various systems, and extensive testing support and documentation of the resulting system.  Responsibilities included the following:  Analysis and creation of interface program specifications, designing, coding, and testing COBOL / DB2 application programs,  assisting other team members in coding / testing issues, assisting with technical and design issues, extensive system testing and support after implementation.

positions.title: Consultant Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
FOS Project

Analyst on the Future Optimum State (FOS) team at Ameritech on a project to re-engineer existing COBOL / DB2 batch applications.  The project involved the re-development of the entire batch system, taking it out of a CASE tool (ADW), and re-programming existing functions, new modifications, and system / acceptance testing the product.  Responsibilities included the following:  Designing, coding, and testing COBOL / DB2 application programs, assisting several other team members in coding / testing issues, assisting with C / Informix technical issues, assisting with project planning / timeline issues, providing technical assistance with KnowledgeWare's ADW.

positions.title: Consultant Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Retirement Services

Programmer/analyst on a team responsible for creating a process to convert, validate and load data into normalized DB2 tables.  Responsibilities included analysis of data mapping and validation issues, and design, coding and testing of process components.   Development was done using COBOL II, DB2 and Lotus Notes.

positions.title: Consultant Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Warehousing/Customer Satisfaction

Programmer/Analyst on teams enhancing multiple existing systems for more efficient use by the end-users.  Responsibilities included the following:  Analyzing and improving DB2 access, system analysis and troubleshooting, working independently with users and coordinating system testing, major enhancements to online system functionality.  Development was done using COBOL II, VSAM, DB2, and CICS.

positions.title: Consultant Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Revolver Card Project

Programmer/Analyst on a team of 7 enhancing the current Card Member Update Processing system.  Responsibilities included the following:  Tracking problem logs and troubleshooting errors, converting modules to compile under MicroFocus COBOL.  Development  was done using MicroFocus COBOL Workbench, COBOL II, VSAM, DB2.
